text:
raj: deploybot just fired a p95 latency alert for hosted/v2 across us-west2, looks like a gradual climb since the 18:00 cutover. should we let the autopilot unwind or do a manual pin/unpin?
deploybot: ALERT at 1821009987 - p95 latency 2.1s (baseline 0.6s). autopilot state: SUPPRESSED (reason: customer-migration-window). suggested action: staggered traffic-unpin -> degrade to v2.3-compat for embeddings route.
emma: thanks for flagging. since autopilot is suppressed we need manual ops. i'm +1 for a targeted unpin on embeddings route only, not full rollback. keep chat completions on current variant.
lina: agree with targeted. also we should update release notes for the customer-facing blurb and post a brief in #general if any user-visible changes happen. @kate can you draft a 1-paragraph note?
kate: on it — will draft and share in 5. recommend saying: "experiencing higher embedding latencies for some requests in us-west2; we are routing to a compat model for a small subset while we investigate." ok?
oliver: quick ask — do we have a safe unpin command that preserves KV cache/streaming sessions? last time we saw cold-cache spikes.
emma: good call. use: `./ops/releasectl unpin --route embeddings --stagger 10% --preserve-kv` (ops-only). staging tested this flow last week. must watch backend cache hit metric.
raj: timeline: execute at 1821010200, ramp 10% every 2 minutes up to 50%, pause and validate, then decide further. who will run?
emma: i'll run the command and own ops steps. @oliver monitor kv-cache-hit and prefix-cache-misses. @lina validate frontend errors and customer telemetry. @kate ready message.
lina: i'll watch error-rate, user-visible latency, and a small synthetic prompt set. will report within 5m of each ramp.
kate: draft posted: "We are routing a subset of embedding requests to a compat model to mitigate elevated p95 latency in us-west2. No action required from customers. More updates to follow." pinging legal?
raj: good. legal not needed for this. quick comms checklist: 1) post draft to #general 2) update release notes (ops-changelog) 3) open an incident-lite with links 4) pin current version in case we need full revert
deploybot: NOTE: autopilot will resume if suppression flag cleared. current suppression: customer-migration-window=true until 1821020000. manual override permitted.
emma: executing now: `releasectl unpin --route embeddings --stagger 10 --preserve-kv` -> starting 10% at 1821010200.
oliver: seeing slight spike in prefix-cache-misses at 1821010255 (+12%). expected, but cache warms.
lina: synthetic tests at 1821010270: embedding quality consistent, latency for routed slice dropped to 0.8s.
kate: posted to #general and updated ops-changelog link: https://redwood.internal/ops-changelog/182101.
raj: good progress. hold for two ramps and then reassess; if error-rate increases >0.5% we rollback the unpin and then evaluate full revert.
emma: ramped to 30% at 1821010320. monitoring.
oliver: kv-cache-hit trending up; no new streaming session errors.
lina: errors stable. no customer complaints so far.
emma: ramped to 50% at 1821010380. pausing to validate.
raj: decision: keep targeted unpin, open follow-up ticket to root cause (likely kernel scheduling + quantization edge path). assign to eng-runtime. also schedule a 1hr postmortem draft in case we need it.
kate: i'll add customer note if status changes. closing thread once eng-runtime is assigned. :white_check_mark:
